scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web && npm run dist -w desktop
scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm run test:run -w web && npm test -w desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web && npm run typecheck -w desktop
